tha-ap195:1.1: Khaṇḍaphulliya.] Phussassa kho bhagavato thūpo āsi mahāvane / kuñjarehi tadā bhinno saṃrūḷho pādapo tahiṃ. // //
tha-ap195:2.1: Visamañ ca samaṃ katvā sudhāpiṇḍaṃ adās' ahaṃ / tilokagaruno tassa guṇehi paritosito. // //
tha-ap195:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammaṃ akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sudhāpiṇḍass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap195:4.1: Sattasattatikappamhi Jitasen' āsuṃ solasa / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap195:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Khaṇḍaphulliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
